parsed.name: QuTech 控制箱 v3
parsed.description: QuTech 控制箱 v3 是一台可编程实验控制电子设备，用于向内部控制核心下发指令、读取主控制器参数，并支持设备参数初始化与功能测试，适合需要确定性时序与固件级控制的实验场景。
parsed.description_en: The QuTech Control Box v3 is a programmable experimental control instrument used to load instructions into its internal control core, read master-controller parameters, and support parameter initialization and functional testing. It is suited for experiments requiring deterministic timing and firmware-level control.
